newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-RHODES MAINTAINS TEST CLAIM.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RHODES MAINTAINS TEST CLAIM.

text.p: Jonty Rhodes underlined his claims to a recall to the South African test side with an undefeated 94 in Natal's four day Supersport Series match against Transvaal in Johannesburg on Friday.
The one-day international specialist continued in his rich vein of form as Natal closed a bad light shortened first day on 294 for four with 17.2 overs still to be bowled.
Rhodes was dropped from the test side against India but has since produced a string of fine performances and he was the pivot of title-chasing Natal's innings at Wanderers.
After a half-century opening stand Natal were in some trouble at 117-4 but Rhodes' partnerships of 41 with Dale Benkenstein and 78 with Neil Johnson restored the innings.
Clive Eksteen was Transvaal's most effectove bowler with figures of four for 66 from 25 overs.
Bowling: Kidwell 12.4-0-63-0, Veenstra 15-2-50-2, Jacobs 18-6-47-0, De Bruyn 14-3-54-1, Eksteen 25-2-66-4 Bacher 2-0-4-0
